name: knowmade
description: Knowmade practical knowledge bases for Codex with goal-directed private work, hub inbox dispatch, public/private topic pairs, fuzzy Idea capture, Project promotion, explicitly trusted private adapters, personal specialist skills, Project Knowledge Checkpoints Export, inventory, datasets, ingestion, audits, sessions, and outputs.

interface.shortDescription: Research, shape Ideas, and export project knowledge checkpoints
interface.longDescription: Bundle the Knowmade workflow for Codex: use private goals as planning context, dispatch mixed-topic hub intake, capture and shape Ideas, apply personal specialist methods, export privacy-sealed Project Knowledge Checkpoints, promote approved briefs into Projects, and maintain public/private topic-scoped sources, compiled knowledge, inventory, datasets, sessions, audits, and outputs.
defaultPrompt: Export a Project Knowledge Checkpoint from relevant research across my topic wikis, with privacy checks.
Triage my hub inbox and route each item to the right public or private topic inbox.
Capture this rough Idea, research it, shape alternatives, and wait for approval before creating a Project.
Run a registered private adapter and review only its wiki-safe evidence candidates.
Research a new topic and compile it into a wiki.
Collect a catalog of examples, tools, memes, media, projects, or source candidates and decide what should become inventory.
Archive an old topic wiki so it stays preserved but out of default context.
Track this source queue as inventory, then ingest selected candidates into my wiki.
Index this large dataset with a manifest, schema notes, samples, and query recipes.
Ingest these notes or an external source collection into my wiki and update the indexes.
Audit this wiki output and tell me if I can trust it.
Lint this wiki and fix structural issues.
Enable automated session capture and rehydrate context for this project.
Review feedback candidates from this session and promote durable corrections into my wiki.
